response.justification: The candidate is a versatile, experienced engineer with a strong background in web, systems programming (DLang, C/C++), and developer tooling, but the resume shows almost no alignment with the core requirements: there is no substantive Java or Kotlin experience, no Spring or enterprise JVM framework work, and no deep JVM expertise. While brief exposure to IDE development (LabWindows/CVI) and current work on developer tooling and MCP code generators show genuine interest in tooling, the fundamental technology mismatch makes this a poor fit for a senior JVM/IDE role.
strengths: Long track record across complex systems, including low-latency, high-throughput services
Genuine developer-tooling interest: IDE component work at National Instruments, test frameworks, MCP code generators
Strong craftsmanship culture (TDD, CI/CD, open source, teaching/workshops)
concerns: No Kotlin experience and only minor, dated Java exposure — core requirement unmet
No Spring, Quarkus, Hibernate, or enterprise JVM ecosystem experience
Recent work is TypeScript/Node-focused, far from JVM internals and language tooling
